my.title: Certificates
my.intro: Certificates from your class programmes. Open one to print it or save it as a PDF for your school portfolio.
my.empty: You have no certificates yet. When your teacher approves a class programme’s results, yours appears here.
my.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your certificates. Try again in a moment.

page.revokedNote: This certificate was revoked, so it can’t be printed. If you think this is a mistake, write to us from Contact us.
page.printHint: In the print window, choose “Save as PDF” to keep a copy for your portfolio.

name.title: Name on the certificate
name.intro: A class certificate may print your real name with the school’s name. It is stored only with this certificate, never on your profile, and it is deleted 30 days after the class is archived. Leave it empty to print your pen name.
name.label: Name to print
name.deletesOn: The name is deleted on {{date}}. Save a copy before then.
name.deleted: The class was archived more than 30 days ago, so the printed name was deleted. The certificate prints your pen name.

verify.title: Check a certificate
verify.intro: Type the code printed on a certificate. We show whether it is valid, the programme, the result and the date, never the student’s name.
verify.retired: This certificate is no longer available.
verify.unknown: We found no certificate with this code. Check it and try again.
verify.loadFailed: We couldn’t check the code. Try again in a moment.

class.title: Certificates
class.intro: Choose a result for each student and approve the list. Your approval is your electronic signature: your name prints as the second signatory, with “signed electronically” and the date.
class.programmeHint: For example “Writing club 2026–2027”. Up to 120 characters.
class.nothingChanged: Nothing changed: every result was already signed.
class.archived: This class is archived, so it issues no more certificates.
class.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the class’s certificates.

settingsCard.title: Certificates
settingsCard.body: Approve a programme’s results and each student gets a certificate under Certificates.

look.title: Colour and pattern
look.intro: Pick how this programme’s certificates look. Students see it on their certificate and in the PDF.
look.patternHint: The same patterns as the covers, in the certificate colour and kept very faint so the text stays easy to read.
look.crestColoursHint: Keep a colourful crest as it is on a plain white seal, or show it in white on the certificate colour.
look.crestHint: PNG, SVG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. A square picture fits best. Every picture is checked automatically before it shows.
look.crestRemoveFailed: We couldn’t remove the crest. Try again.

crestStates.none: No crest yet. Until one is uploaded and checked, the cat shows.
crestStates.checking: Being checked. It shows in a minute or two; until then, the cat shows.
crestStates.waiting_for_person: A moderator looks at it first. Until then, the cat shows.
crestStates.visible: Checked. It shows in the seal.
crestStates.removed: This crest was taken down. Upload another, or choose the cat.
